integrity: The dimension-uniform proof is combinatorial and topological. Finite Smith-form checks cover d=3,4 and a mod-two check covers d=5; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Integral homology of ordinary three-cut complexes and a homotopy decomposition of their Alexander dual are proved for d>=3; no homotopy type of the cut complexes themselves or equivariant representation is claimed. Published dimension-three case is credited. Equivalent unindexed work remains possible.
title: Integral homology of three-cut complexes of all hypercubes
